default.title: Private workspaces, reliable navigation, and visible releases
default.summary: ClawPilot now separates user workspaces and credentials, gives administrators a complete access surface, and records product changes in durable Postgres-backed release notes.
features: Branded welcome invitations from ClawPilot Stewards with invitation-bound magic-code activation
User-specific documents with generated build, project, pipeline, and AI opportunity briefs
Admin-controlled full release history and logical data checkpoints
Persistent desktop sidebar collapse, mobile navigation drawer, and compact bottom navigation
ClawPilot product mark across the application, browser icon, welcome flow, and email
fixes: Prevented the desktop sidebar from overlaying and cropping page content on touch-width layouts
Prevented expired or revoked invitations from bypassing activation through normal sign-in
Replaced hosted Git and local-file backup discovery with durable release and checkpoint records
Removed stale promotion and cross-project document categories from the Docs experience
